mapper.sql: config_id, user_id, username, real_name, user_type, commission_type, commission_value, min_commission, max_commission, effective_time, expiry_time, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, deleted_at, version, tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_commission_config WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND user_id = #{userId} AND (effective_time IS NULL OR effective_time <= NOW()) AND (expiry_time IS NULL OR expiry_time > NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ucc.config_id, ucc.user_id, ucc.username, ucc.real_name, ucc.user_type, CASE ucc.user_type WHEN 1 THEN '采购员' WHEN 2 THEN '管理员' ELSE '未知' END AS user_type_name, ucc.commission_type, CASE ucc.commission_type WHEN 1 THEN '固定金额' WHEN 2 THEN '百分比' ELSE '未知' END AS commission_type_name, ucc.commission_value, ucc.min_commission, ucc.max_commission, ucc.effective_time, ucc.expiry_time, ucc.status, CASE ucc.status WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name, ucc.remark, ucc.created_by, ucc.created_at, ucc.updated_by, ucc.updated_at FROM user_commission_config ucc WHERE ucc.is_deleted = 0 AND ucc.config_id = #{configId}

SELECT ucc.config_id, ucc.user_id, ucc.username, ucc.real_name, ucc.user_type, CASE ucc.user_type WHEN 1 THEN '采购员' WHEN 2 THEN '管理员' ELSE '未知' END AS user_type_name, ucc.commission_type, CASE ucc.commission_type WHEN 1 THEN '固定金额' WHEN 2 THEN '百分比' ELSE '未知' END AS commission_type_name, ucc.commission_value, ucc.min_commission, ucc.max_commission, ucc.effective_time, ucc.expiry_time, ucc.status, CASE ucc.status WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name, ucc.remark, ucc.created_by, ucc.created_at, ucc.updated_by, ucc.updated_at FROM user_commission_config ucc WHERE ucc.is_deleted = 0 AND ucc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ucc.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.user_type, CASE u.user_type WHEN 1 THEN '采购员' WHEN 2 THEN '管理员' ELSE '未知' END AS user_type_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
AND u.user_type = #{userType}
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
